planning_notes: Preserve the supplied wiring: D2 and D3 connect to GND with INPUT_PULLUP, the potentiometer uses A0, and the PWM LED uses D9. Button model values are already normalized to true when pressed.

The SysML model starts in automatic mode with brightness zero and rising. It generates a repeated linear 0-to-255-to-0 ramp using actual elapsed time, with a configurable duration initially set to 2000 ms per direction.
Treat each new D2 press as an automatic-mode selection that restarts the rise from zero, including when automatic mode is already selected. A D3 press selects manual mode.
In manual mode, the SysML model maps the Uno ADC range 0..1023 linearly to PWM commands 0..255. Conversion and command limiting belong in the model, not in adapter calibration.
Simultaneous D2 and D3 press priority is unspecified and remains a model-level decision.
Button mode changes and manual PWM changes must be reflected within 250 ms. The 5 ms control period is scheduling granularity, not the ramp duration.
